events.question: How can AI make us all money?
events.blurb: Opening night. One hard question, and a room of people willing to think it through together — chat, callers, and anyone who wants to help. Not a lecture. A gathering.
events.join: Come to the live chat on YouTube. Bring a thought, a doubt, or a small idea. Help us work the question — or follow along and see what comes out of tonight.
